content.comment_body: I'm looking to capture the first value from an analog input using the [product_name] expansion module. I only need the initial analog-to-digital value during the first PLC cycle, which I want to store in a variable. The rest of the analog readings are not important for now. At the moment, I'm trying to use the MOV_BIR block (Move Byte Immediate Read), but I'm getting an error. Does anyone have an example for this approach? Thanks for your help!
Hello, This sounds like you're referring to a [version_no] system. Try using SM 0.1 to move AIW to a Vw or MW register. Regards, [user_name]
Hi, could you please provide the complete [article_no]? Regards
Thanks! That's exactly right. I didn't consider doing it that way before. Really appreciate your help. Hope you have a great day...

analysis.insight_summary: The user wanted to capture the initial analog input reading from a [product_name] module at the beginning of a PLC operation. They ran into complications with the MOV_BIR block, but received community advice to use a straightforward memory operation in the PLC instead, which proved to be a practical solution.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to reliably read and store the first analog input value using basic programming logic and avoid errors originating from specific function blocks.
